text:
Dana Liu: hit a repeat-create in the onboarding flow. stack: node-sdk v1.4.2 behind our api-gateway. sequence: token refresh triggered, upstream returned 429, SDK retried and server created two resources.

Hector Alvarez: gateway rebuilds the forwarded request during auth refresh, maybe dropping non-whitelisted headers. which header was lost?

Dana Liu: Idempotency-Key. sample-app sets it explicitly but after the middleware replay it's gone. logs: 
``n2026-04-05T08:11:09Z INFO POST /v1/items id=itm_42
2026-04-05T08:11:09Z WARN auth refresh start
2026-04-05T08:11:09Z ERROR upstream 429
2026-04-05T08:11:09Z INFO retry attempt=1 headers(Idempotency-Key)=<missing>
2026-04-05T08:11:09Z INFO POST /v1/items id=itm_42
``n
Kavya Rao: ouch. We need parity across SDKs: preserve user headers on replay, and add a client-side short replay cache. My proposal: default preserve list includes ["Idempotency-Key","X-Request-Meta-*"], and SDKs synthesize a local replay id when no idempotency key present (store hash for 20s).

Hector Alvarez: for backoff, standardize on full jitter (sleep = random(0, min(max, base*2^attempt))). base=200ms, max=5s. Full jitter reduces thundering herd.

Dana Liu: also add a strictMode flag (default false). strictMode=true => do not auto-retry POST/PUT without Idempotency-Key. This gives customers a migration path.

Kavya Rao: QA items: unit test for auth refresh + 429 ensuring single create, integration parity test across node/go/python samples, and a flaky test simulating gateway header filtering.

infra-bot: Created ticket DEX-4510: "node-sdk/gateway: preserve idempotency header across auth retries + local replay cache + strictMode" https://redwood.atlassian/browse/DEX-4510

devex-bot: Please add telemetry events: sdk.replay.header_dropped, sdk.replay.local_dedup, sdk.replay.strict_blocked.

Dana Liu: I'll open a small PR to whitelist Idempotency-Key in gateway and add the local cache client-side. Will include telemetry and tests.

Hector Alvarez: double-check streaming resume path too; same middleware used there. If affected open follow-up DEX-4511.

Kavya Rao: thanks. also update onboarding docs to show Idempotency-Key examples and explain strictMode behavior.

Dana Liu: PR incoming in a few hours, ping me for review.
